items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: That's a piano tune with David Williamson.

ctx.x: Well we had Martin Cole on the boat with us. He had got shot in his stomach one time and we used him on the boat, you know, short trip. Then he left and then he went out there fooling around with Claiborne Williamson, he was running his band while he was in the Navy down there. I was waiting for Buckaroo. That's a piano tune. That's a piano tune with David Williamson.
You know we were talking to Benny Turner and he told us to play with Williamson too and his piano when he was in the Navy.
